_purpose: Force-include list for the natural-features pipeline. Every entry here MUST appear in its country's tier 1 for its kind after ranking. build_features.py seeds these by QID before the harvest, rank_features.py may reorder them but may not drop them, and validate_features.py fails the build when one is absent. Seeds also bypass the filter rules in features_filter_rules.json: a curated entry outranks a pattern.
_rules: only entries the reviewer marked verified:true
every row carries a coordinate and a source URL
qid may be null only where no Wikidata item exists (12 rows, all HU and PL bathing beaches sourced from OSM)

every coordinate was re-tested against the country boundary (NUTS3 2021 / Natural Earth 50m) before inclusion; a border ridge summit such as Mont Blanc is deliberately seeded in both countries that claim it
